pages.title: Hummingbird | Laura Faichney All Things Art
pages.description: A colourful hummingbird artwork with vivid blue, turquoise, pink and gold details, presented in a white frame with a small gold heart accent.

pages.title: Mad cow | Laura Faichney All Things Art
pages.description: ‘Mad cow’ - a 60 × 90 cm original created for the Jack Daniel Ball Auction at Fitzpatrick’s Castle on 2 October, raising funds for Aoibheann’s Pink Tie. The event is organised by Gina Hogan and her team, with all proceeds supporting the charity.

pages.title: Coco After Dark | Laura Faichney All Things Art
pages.description: ‘Coco After Dark’ - a one-of-a-kind original acrylic on stretched canvas, finished with a high-gloss surface. 60 × 75 cm and available for sale.

pages.title: Wild at heart | Laura Faichney All Things Art
pages.description: ‘Wild at heart’ - a bold 50 × 50 cm acrylic on stretched canvas with a high-gloss finish. One of three pieces heading to an upcoming exhibition and available for sale.

pages.title: Angus Has Notions | Laura Faichney All Things Art
pages.description: ‘Angus Has Notions’ is a 50 × 50 cm acrylic painting on stretched canvas, the second of three pieces I created for an upcoming exhibition. It’s available for sale, so contact me if you’d like to know more.
